title: A Fight Over Abortion and Surrogacy Ends With a Baby Born in Texas
summary: The baby, who was born Wednesday with a severe heart defect, drew the attention of anti-abortion activists and the Texas attorney general after the intended parents wanted the surrogate mother to have an abortion.
